decisions.reason: The flagship transactional email service sits on the home page and fits the firm's strategic direction toward cloud enterprise messaging, so it will be kept and developed.
Document capture extends the firm's electronic document workflow offering and has a page of its own, which signals continued investment.
Email and fax conversion is a low-cost extension of the core messaging infrastructure that regulated customers still use, so keeping it makes sense.
This fax optimization feature is tightly integrated into the established fax business and costs little to keep, though fax is in long-term decline.
Sandbox threat protection strengthens the email security portfolio, which is in growing demand among compliance-focused customers.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a core component of the secure messaging service and is unlikely to be withdrawn.
